channel.title: Advanced: lectures and slides on Teaching materials with Hugo
channel.description: Recent content in Advanced: lectures and slides on Teaching materials with Hugo

item.title: Slide layouts and types
item.description: Every class in the theme’s slide-types.css, and the cols/rows/gap layout params. The last three entries are a slide shared with Code on slides, a slide that doesn’t exist and a wrongly capitalised path: the missing one is skipped without any warning (look at the contents slide), and the capitalised one is found anyway.

item.title: Pictures, video, diagrams and live examples on slides
item.description: Images from assets and from a slide’s own folder, figure, YouTube, iframe, Mermaid, and per-slide and per-lecture CSS.

item.title: A very long lecture
item.description: Twenty-four slides, reused from other lectures, so the contents slide needs three columns. The first slide has far too much on it.
